title: Technical Support Engineer (Product/SaaS)
summary: Technical support engineers help a software company's customers when the product does not work as expected, by reproducing the problem, finding the cause and guiding the fix. They sit in the customer support team between customers and the engineering team, and often work in shifts that match customer time zones.
dailyDuties: Respond to and resolve customer tickets within SLA
Reproduce reported issues in a test account of the product
Run SQL queries and read API logs to find the root cause
Escalate confirmed bugs to engineering in Jira with steps to reproduce
Join calls with customers to debug integrations
Write and update knowledge base articles

skills.expectation: Reproduce customer issues in the product, find the root cause and suggest a fix or workaround
Own customer tickets in Zendesk, Freshdesk or a similar tool and meet response SLAs
Write SQL queries to check customer data and investigate data issues
Read API requests, responses, logs and HTTP status codes to debug integrations
Understand DNS, HTTP and network basics behind connection problems
Escalate confirmed bugs to engineering in Jira with clear reproduction steps
Write clear replies and knowledge base articles for customers
Narrow down unclear problems methodically under time pressure
Send test API calls with Postman or cURL
Read server logs and run basic commands
Script small checks and support automations
Inspect web pages with browser developer tools
Understand how the product runs on the cloud

certifications.why: Basic cloud vocabulary for support on cloud-hosted products
Basic cloud vocabulary for products hosted on Azure
